release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD816A-360ZK4F is a bi-spectrum cooled-thermal (MCT MWIR) stable PTZ with a 640x512 cooled detector, 4 MP optical PTZ channel and a fixed wide-angle overlay lens, built for extreme-range perimeter and coastal surveillance in haze and fog. Verified against the official HikMicro datasheet HM-TD816A-360ZK4F_G0_T2_Datasheet_en-US_20260817.pdf.
